title: On EmDash a write step line that failed only for want of a door is skipped and says so, never read as a refusal of the site
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: notOnPlatform makes a failed EmDash line whose reason is not_on_emdash or a closed info door skipped with "not on EmDash yet: <reason>", keeps a refusal of the site failed, and changes nothing on Joomla; the JA Diner EmDash write step run with SEO words skips page-home:title and page-home:description with those words and leaves no failed line of that kind.

tests: on EmDash a line that failed only for want of a door is skipped and says so; any other failure stays
an EmDash Diner run writes its words into the entries and empties the hidden slot, through the contract alone
